name: Arena, Spectator Seats
desc1: This circular chamber overlooks the arena floor down below. Rows of
desc2: stone steps circling the arena serve as seats, and provide a good view
desc3: of any battle or contest going on. Two steep stairwells descend into
desc4: the arena itself, while two passages exit the area-- into the entry
desc5: hall to the north, and into the training rooms to the east.
